issues.where: crop C upper-right solar disk (also image-03.png crop M upper-left and image-01.png upper-center disk)
issues.what: an axis-aligned 90-degree rectangular patch corner and seam cuts across the solar granulation where a darker orange tile meets a paler yellow region
issues.fix: blend or regenerate the solar surface texture seamlessly across 3D/UV patch boundaries so no straight vertical or horizontal tile edges remain

issues.where: crop A upper crescent terminator and interior of the planet (also image-07.png crop P and image-05.png center)
issues.what: the inner edge of the backlit crescent forms a doubled ring with an unnatural orange-to-cyan/green color fringe, while the dark nightside is blotchy and soft with stray bright white/pink pixel specks near 1-2 o'clock
issues.fix: smooth the atmospheric scattering falloff across the terminator without chromatic ringing, sharpen and unify the nightside surface detail, and remove the stray bright pixel fireflies/bleed-through

issues.where: crops A, E, and G solar limb and prominences (also image-03.png crops L, N, and R)
issues.what: the coronal prominence loops are noticeably blurry and airbrushed at native scale compared to the crisp photosphere granulation, and a hard geometric rim line separates the right sphere edge from the corona
issues.fix: increase fine filament detail in the coronal loops to match native pixel sharpness and soften the photosphere-to-chromosphere limb transition

issues.where: crop C lower-left active region (also image-03.png crop L lower-right and crop R upper-left)
issues.what: bright solar highlights clip to flat, featureless white patches and adjacent granulation appears softer and lower-contrast than the upper-right globe
issues.fix: preserve high-frequency granulation detail in bright active regions with smoother highlight roll-off instead of hard white clipping

issues.where: crop A lower-left planet limb around 7-8 o'clock (also image-07.png crop P)
issues.what: the thin backlit orange rim breaks into jagged single-pixel stair-steps with smeared diagonal streaks just inside the limb
issues.fix: apply higher supersampling/anti-aliasing along the thin grazing-angle atmospheric rim and fix texture stretching near the limb

issues.where: crops K and L lower-middle corona left of the solar limb (also image-01.png left of limb)
issues.what: a strictly horizontal bright streak extends straight left across the K/L boundary like a screen-space bloom artifact rather than radial coronal structure
issues.fix: use radially isotropic bloom or volumetric coronal rays instead of axis-aligned horizontal blur streaks

issues.where: globe in crop A, lit cloud banks
issues.what: clouds jump from dark ocean to flat near-white in one or two pixels, and the terrain under them is soft and airbrushed
issues.fix: feather the cloud edges and add finer structure in the clouds and coastlines

issues.where: limb and disk of the reddish globe in crop A
issues.what: the surface is smooth, and the orange limb drops to a thin blue fringe in about two pixels instead of blending
issues.fix: soften the limb and widen the atmospheric falloff into the surface

issues.where: small moon, lower right of the globe crop
issues.what: the moon is a soft speck about a dozen pixels across, with no resolved surface
issues.fix: shade a small resolved body, or keep it a dim point

issues.where: crop A, right side of the rings
issues.what: The planet shadow reads as a near-black cutout with ruler-straight edges; it abruptly wipes out the ring bands and chops off the bright outer rim.
issues.fix: Project the globe's umbra and penumbra onto the ring plane and preserve subtle ring structure through the shadow transition.

issues.where: crop Q, lit globe and blue polar cap
issues.what: The blue cap is a soft spot and the surrounding cloud bands are smooth concentric arcs, giving the globe an airbrushed finish.
issues.fix: Break up the cap and bands with subtle, irregular cloud detail while keeping the broad color transitions.

issues.where: crop C, lit rock beneath the dark upper-right face
issues.what: Fine rock grain becomes dense, high-contrast speckle on the lit ridges while the nearby shadowed pits look comparatively soft.
issues.fix: Reduce the finest bump contrast and retain more mid-scale relief and tonal separation inside the pits.

issues.where: crops S and V, brightest stars
issues.what: A few bright stars spread into soft round blobs instead of retaining tight cores.
issues.fix: Tighten the star cores and reserve broader bloom for the brightest points.

issues.where: moon at upper left (~395,185), all round its limb
issues.what: a dark ring a few pixels wide surrounds the moon and blocks out the stars behind it, so it reads as a cut-out pasted onto the sky; the limb also steps in visible pixels
issues.fix: stop the occlusion mask at the true limb (no dilated black matte), antialias the edge, and render the moon at a higher internal resolution

issues.where: blue planet (~700,583), area just outside the limb and the ring ellipses
issues.what: a dark disc reaches past the limb and darkens the sky and stars around the planet. The rings are only faint dark concentric lines that look like a halo or a ripple artifact, not lit ring material
issues.fix: remove the dark matte or shadow outside the limb, give the rings a lit, translucent particle look with forward-scatter brightness, and let the stars show through the gaps

issues.where: crops F and E (Milky Way core, lower centre of image-25); image-28 crop U; image-32 crop W
issues.what: the galactic dust has repeated diagonal brush-stroke streaks, a smeared painted or flow-noise texture that looks airbrushed rather than like fractal dust lanes
issues.fix: replace the directional streak noise with multi-octave fractal dust and filament structure at varied scales, and break up the repeated stroke direction

issues.where: lower edge of the Milky Way band (~450-1050, 650-788) and the right-hand blob (~900-1050, 540-700)
issues.what: the nebula ends in rounded, blob-shaped clumps with fairly clean outlines, like separate patches stamped on the sky
issues.fix: feather the band's falloff over a much larger distance and add faint diffuse glow and dust beyond the bright clumps

issues.where: upper right sky (~850-1100, 0-250) and the left side of the Milky Way band
issues.what: the faint blue-grey haze patches are smooth and featureless, with soft but noticeable patch edges against the black
issues.fix: add low-contrast structure and grain to the haze, or reduce its opacity so it blends in

issues.where: star field everywhere (e.g. image-26 crop C, image-27 crops J-L)
issues.what: stars are single-pixel or 2x2 squares of nearly uniform size, with no PSF falloff on the bright ones, so the field looks like a stippled noise texture
issues.fix: render the stars with a proper point-spread function, give them a wider magnitude range, and add a faint glow to the brightest

issues.where: planet disc
issues.what: the cloud bands are soft and slightly smeared at native size, and the terminator is smooth and airbrushed with little detail
issues.fix: raise the planet texture resolution and add fine band turbulence and detail near the terminator

issues.where: Milky Way band across tiles B, C, E, F, G, H (and image-39.png tiles J, K, L)
issues.what: the Milky Way background texture is visibly blocky, pixelated, and blurry at native crop scale, with smeared dust lanes and baked-in stars stretched into large fuzzy blobs (such as lower-left of tile C / lower-right of tile F) beneath crisp 1-pixel point stars
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution skybox texture with a higher-resolution or procedural galactic dust map that holds up at 1:1 pixel scale and remove baked-in blurry star blobs

issues.where: illuminated right and lower-right limb in tiles B, D, I (and image-39.png tiles N, O)
issues.what: a doubled edge with an inner dark trough separates the outer atmospheric glow from the globe along the lower-right crescent limb, and the inner sphere horizon forms a jagged stair-stepped cyan line inside the atmosphere
issues.fix: compute continuous optical-depth falloff across the limb and supersample the sphere-to-atmosphere transition so no dark seam, doubled rim, or aliased inner edge appears

issues.where: illuminated upper limb in tiles B, H, I (and image-35.png tiles K, N, O)
issues.what: the geometric horizon of the planet cuts a hard, stair-stepped bright cyan line right through the softer atmospheric limb glow
issues.fix: antialias the globe silhouette and blend surface scattering smoothly into the outer atmospheric halo across the horizon

issues.where: Neptune cloud deck and Great Dark Spot in tiles N, O (and image-34.png tiles D, H; image-39.png tiles N, O)
issues.what: the planetary surface texture is soft, blurry, and airbrushed at native resolution, lacking fine cloud structure compared to the crisp stars and geometry
issues.fix: increase the planetary texture resolution or layer high-frequency procedural cloud detail so the cloud bands and storm stay sharp in 1:1 crops

issues.where: curved outer ringlets in tiles B, I and unlit planet limb in image-39.png tile N and image-36.png tiles S, T
issues.what: jagged pixel stair-stepping is visible along the narrow bright ring arcs and along the dark silhouette edge of the globe against the starfield
issues.fix: apply higher multisample or supersample antialiasing to the planet geometry silhouette and ring shader evaluation
